en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a narrow, sloping street with a prominent neo‑Gothic chapel building in the foreground. The chapel has pointed arches, ornate tracery, and a tall spire-like structure above its entrance. Gas lamps, cobblestones, and several pedestrians are visible along the descending street that leads toward a river or open area in the distance. Printed caption text in German appears at the bottom.
